references.text: The Levites had no inheritance in the land, for the Lord himself was their inheritance and portion.
Do not forget the Levite living among you, for he has no inheritance with you.
The tithe of the third year shall be given to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow.
Care for the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow at harvest time.
God's command to protect the foreigner, the widow, and the fatherless.
God is a father to the fatherless and a defender of widows.
Pure and undefiled religion means caring for the fatherless and widows in their distress.
The promise that the Lord will bless all your work when you give to those in need.
What remains after harvest shall be for the poor and the foreigner.
The Lord upholds the cause of the fatherless and the widow, and loves the foreigner.
